blocking_issues: No physical iPhone profile exists for this candidate. Frame time, touch latency, memory, and thermal targets at 100,000 and 1,000,000 assets remain unverified on target hardware.

Build 358 direct-source CI passed on commit 1c618ad (run 37077522739: 147/147 source gates, unsigned arm64 iPhoneOS Release build); the recorded artifact block below still belongs to Build 357 (commit af36368). Later commits are verified by their own runs.

Fleet JSON persistence admits purchases up to 6,000 records (live assets plus pending delivery snapshots; delivered receipts are compact since Build 358). Save Schema now validates assets per class of identically-read rows (trusted pass 61 ms at 100,000 assets in Node), but the save is still one JSON text: chunked binary persistence in the native vault is not implemented, so saves above ~120,000 assets exceed the 30 MB native ceiling and million-asset save/load is not supported.
The daily close still runs in one slice (~60 ms on the development VM with 300 aircraft and 100 Mobility vehicles, dominated by document-signed trip settlement); it is not frame-budgeted.
Manual advance consults adapter.getManualSliceLimit and estimates a slice from a 1,500-event window, with 60-second and 3,600-second bounds; actual per-frame timing still needs iPhone profiling.
The incremental spatial index and device-scale map/list rendering profile remain unverified.
